text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick Q — can I add the ID card to Apple Wallet/Google Wallet? Heading to urgent care and want quick proof.
Benefits Bot: Hi Maya 44b Some carriers provide a QR that can be added to mobile wallets. Go to Benefits Portal -> My Benefits -> Insurance Cards -> 'Add to Wallet' if present. SSO required.
Ethan K.: I tried 'Add to Wallet' but it asked me to download a .pkpass and then opened Wallet. Worked fine.
Lina Z.: FYI the wallet pass sometimes hides the Rx BIN/PCN on preview; open the card or download PDF for full routing fields.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks. What if the clinic can't scan the QR? They said they need member ID and plan phone.
Jorge (Benefits Admin): If QR scan fails, show the wallet pass details (tap the card) to display member ID and plan phone. If still missing, open the PDF from portal which has full front/back fields.
Ethan K.: For offline/airplane mode, Wallet still shows the pass locally. PDF saved to phone also works offline.
Lina Z.: Note for dependents: switch subscriber dropdown before adding to wallet — otherwise you'll add your card vs dependent's.
Maya (People Ops): Good catch. One more: for telemedicine visit they only asked for member ID and DOB. Should I share the whole PDF?
Jorge (Benefits Admin): For telemed share only what's needed (member ID, DOB). Avoid sending full PDF with SSN if you can crop. Telemed vendors usually accept member ID + DOB + employer.
Maya (People Ops): Great — adding to Wallet now. Thanks all :raised_hands: Closing thread.
